Hello to service crew,
Visitor flow came up at handover, so just a quick note

Please keep the Companion Animal Travel Desk lane clear and guide any travelers with animals toward the posted check-in point. Every animal receives patient attention from trained staff, and the handoff should stay calm, steady, and easy to follow. When you see carriers, leashes, or documentation in the queue, send the case to our desk without delay so we can review it in the right order.

If a traveler reports a disruption after boarding, stay composed and direct them to the correct service path. <<FACT F120>> Keep your notes brief and factual, and pass any special handling detail to the next shift before you leave the area. If you are unsure whether a case needs escalation, bring it to the senior coordinator rather than guessing. The department shares practical instructions with crews, and that support helps us keep the process consistent for every arrival and transfer.

Please also remind travelers that carriers must stay secured and pets must remain with their approved handler unless staff advise otherwise. If a traveler appears anxious, use plain language and avoid crowding the work area. This keeps the flow stable for everyone and reduces avoidable backtracking at the desk.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
